_note: Level L->L+1 costs 'upgrade_cost' * (L). Max level is capped at the Scroll cap; raising the cap from C to C+1 costs cap_scrolls[C-1] Scrolls of Upgrade (hard cap 'max'). Sum of cap_scrolls over all facilities = total Scroll supply (DECISIONS #150).

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: Forge & upgrade gear (+1 per level cap), repair cracked gear, melt spare rings.

alchemy.name: Alchemy Pot
alchemy.desc: Brew potions. Lv2: Starter Elixirs. Potion belt = level+1.

guild.name: Guild Hall
guild.desc: Supplies & Offline Patrols (2h/4h/8h by level). Rations and torches per expedition: 3/6/10 by level.

enchanter.name: Enchanter's Desk
enchanter.desc: Identify curios over time (faster per level); scribe Scrolls of Passage.
